book.skycraft.explore_note_menhir_verse: Verse on a Scrap of Vellum
explore.skycraft.ayleid_well.restored: The welkynd stone hums, and your magicka floods back.
explore.skycraft.ayleid_well.spent: The well is dim. Its power will return tomorrow.
explore.skycraft.lead.revealed: The note mentions a place. Your map has been updated: %s
explore.skycraft.treasure_map.found: You found the cache marked on %s.
explore.skycraft.treasure_map.marked: You study the map and mark the spot on your own.
explore.skycraft.unique.ashfall.lore: Forged in a hot spring's steam; it still smells of sulphur.
explore.skycraft.unique.ashguard_cuirass: Bonemold hardened in the ashfall of the Red Year.
Cut from a cliff racer's tail and sharpened on volcanic glass.
explore.skycraft.unique.atmoran_rime_axe: From the old country, before the long ships sailed south.
explore.skycraft.unique.blackwood_cleave: A legion axe notched by mudcrab shells and worse.
explore.skycraft.unique.colovian_greaves: Worn soft by a thousand leagues of highland trails.
explore.skycraft.unique.crystal_singers_: It rings, very faintly, when the wearer hums.
explore.skycraft.unique.dune_strider_boo: Stitched for the sands; they never fill with grit.
explore.skycraft.unique.frostfang.lore: Its edge never warms, even beside a hearth.
explore.skycraft.unique.green_pact_bow.l: Bone and sinew, no wood: as the Pact demands.
explore.skycraft.unique.hearthwarden.lor: Carried by a housecarl who outlived three jarls and retired to the tundra.
explore.skycraft.unique.hist_bark_cuiras: Shaped from bark the Hist shed willingly. It is still faintly warm.
explore.skycraft.unique.kynes_feather.lo: A hawk's feather sealed in silver. The wind seems to catch you when you fall.
Taken from a fort's last guard by the bandits who now use his tower.
explore.skycraft.unique.lindai_gleam.lor: Ayleid steel that glows faintly near the restless dead.
explore.skycraft.unique.redoran_watch_sh: The house colours are flaked away; the dents are all in front.
explore.skycraft.unique.rivenspire_mourn: A widow's ring, engraved with a name that someone tried to scratch out.
explore.skycraft.unique.riverwyrm_fang.l: Pulled from the jaw of something that lived in the marsh. The marsh wants it back.
explore.skycraft.unique.sand_dancer_boot: Light enough to leap from a cliff and land like a cat. Almost.
Knitted for a scholar whose ink froze every winter. The ink still froze.
explore.skycraft.unique.spore_warden_hel: Worn by the gardeners of a Telvanni tower to breathe among the spores.
explore.skycraft.unique.starstone_amulet: A ruby cut in the old Yokudan way, said to have fallen from the sky.
explore.skycraft.unique.stormcrow.lore: Its string hums before a storm, and its shafts fly true into the wind.
A sword-singer's curved blade, left as an offering where the ancestors stopped.
explore.skycraft.unique.swampfang_mace.l: Studded with the teeth of something that is, fortunately, extinct.
explore.skycraft.unique.thorn_of_glenumb: A knight's sword, buried at a standing stone after a vow was broken.
explore.skycraft.unique.thornheart_cuira: Grown, not made; it still sprouts a thorn now and then.
explore.skycraft.unique.tide_ring.lore: Cold and damp to the touch, always, as if just pulled from the sea.
explore.skycraft.unique.tsaesci_fang.lor: Folded a thousand times by smiths with no hands, they say.
Its blade shows two pale reflections, even in daylight.
The seal of a vineyard that burned in the Crisis. Its owner kept the ring, and nothing else.
explore.skycraft.unique.wanderers_circle: Worn by a woman who walked every road in the Rift and wrote none of it down.
explore.skycraft.unique.wrothgar_icebrea: An Orsimer mining hammer that has broken more than rock.
item.skycraft.treasure_map.blank: The ink has run; nothing can be read.
item.skycraft.treasure_map.hint: Use it to study the drawing. Look for a cairn of stones.
item.skycraft.treasure_map.where: A sketch of the land in %s
